data.narrative:
Vannevar Labs is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Brett Granberg and Nini Moorhead that has raised $90M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private-stage peers in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Allen Control Systems, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, and Twenty.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $90M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implying a valuation of $171M. Peer-median analysis across the 8 same-sector, same-stage private comparables yields a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. These methods reflect meaningfully different signals: the stage-progression method anchors to capital deployed, while peer-median reflects market pricing for functionally comparable companies.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $145M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median point estimate of $648M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects uncertainty around whether Vannevar's capital efficiency, customer traction, or technology differentiation justifies positioning at the higher end of the peer distribution. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and technology IP defensibility relative to the peer set.
